title: web.read input
description: One public web page to read through the declared obscura adapter. R0: the page is loaded and read, nothing on it is clicked or submitted.

offset.description: Character of the page text to start from (default 0); a page longer than max_chars names the next offset at its end. Converted PDF text is capped at 8388608 bytes — at most one character per byte — so every position a window can name fits.
